settings.editor: A vibrant autonomous institution where curiosity becomes capability—and every learner finds the confidence to shape what comes next.

settings.title: A place to become more you.

settings.editor: Since 1961, Sangamner College has opened doors for learners across the region. Our classrooms connect academic depth with practical experience, strong values, and a community that notices every student.
Labs, fieldwork, projects and internships turn knowledge into confident action.
Research, digital learning and interdisciplinary programs expand every horizon.
Mentors, peers and an active campus community make progress deeply personal.
Choose a pathway that matches your curiosity and builds the skills the world needs.
Read culture, understand society, and discover new ways to tell human stories.
Question the known, test possibilities, and build solutions through discovery.
Understand markets, lead organizations, and create responsible enterprise.
Build industry-ready expertise with focused, practical learning pathways.
Notices, deadlines and important updates—all in one place.
It gives me immense pleasure to communicate with you all as the Chairman of an institution rooted in enduring values.
Established to spread knowledge unto the last, we continue to serve as a lighthouse for rural youth.
Academic, cultural and community events will appear here.
